title: Consultations
content: A consultation is the appropriate first step for personalized treatment questions. A qualified provider reviews goals, relevant history, suitability, expected outcomes, and risks before recommending a service.

title: Appointment requests
content: Appointment requests require a preferred service, date range, and contact method. Availability is confirmed by a team member; the assistant does not promise a specific appointment time.

title: Pricing policy
content: Pricing depends on the service and individualized plan. The team confirms current pricing during the consultation process; the assistant does not invent estimates or guarantee promotions.

title: Treatment preparation
content: Preparation instructions vary by treatment and medical history. Follow only the instructions issued by the treating provider, and contact the clinic if those instructions are missing or unclear.

title: Aftercare guidance
content: Aftercare varies by treatment. Follow the written instructions from the treating provider. Contact the clinic for treatment-specific questions, and seek urgent medical help for severe or rapidly worsening symptoms.

title: Cancellations and rescheduling
content: Cancellation and rescheduling policies depend on the provider. A team member must verify the appointment and explain any applicable notice requirements or fees.
